finding_dispositions.evidence: The static initialization objects/database symlink, unsupported-filesystem, and direct fanout-symlink cases now reject without changing their targets, but the live publication boundary remains bypassable after initialization: replacing the empty top-level repository objects directory with a symlink to an external owner-only directory, then calling ObjectRepository.put_verified, raised RepositoryConfigurationError only at the later ConnectionFactory.open layout check after creating the digest fanout and published object hard link under the external target. This independently reproduced on exact r2 and leaves the original verify-all-ancestors/zero-mutation requirement unresolved.

On exact r2, a lease issued at 100 with expiry 150 returned false at observed time 200 and remained false after rollback to 120; clock_high_water_ns persisted 200. All trusted_now call sites used for acquire, renew, validate, task commit, and claim start execute inside explicit write transactions.

An independent b-then-a cross-token probe now raises RepositoryConfigurationError before acquiring a, and the gate-bound opposing-process test proves the reverse side fails finitely rather than deadlocking while the canonical a-then-b side encounters only the existing external conflict.

Direct caller-built CommitBatch claim deltas with missing, extra, empty, stale-token, or wrong-lease resource sets are checked against the complete ordered lease_resources rows and the task commit lease. The prior incomplete resource claim counterexample now raises RepositoryIntegrityError and commits no claim.

Doctor and backup connections now use SQLite mode=ro, query_only=ON, and a read-only authorizer. Independent WITH-prefixed UPDATE probes for both roles raised RepositoryConfigurationError, and the gate tests also cover disguised UPDATE, DELETE, and INSERT without repository mutation.

recover now validates digest grammar, exact transaction event batch, and authoritative full-task replay under installation/object locks. Independent forged transaction head recovery raised RepositoryIntegrityError; gate-bound mutations cover event index/transaction ID and transaction revision/head/task corruption for both replay and recover.

findings.summary: Object publication still follows a replaced top-level objects-directory symlink and mutates an external path before repository layout rejection.
findings.evidence: On exact r2 source 5217163f6d..., after normal repository initialization I removed the empty top-level objects directory and replaced it with a symlink to an external owner-only directory. ObjectRepository.put_verified(b"top-level-objects-symlink", digest) created the digest fanout and final hard-linked body below the external target, then raised RepositoryConfigurationError only when the later metadata ConnectionFactory.open called _verify_layout. The external target contained both the fanout directory and full object after rejection. storage/graph_engineering/storage/objects.py resolves self._objects as a pathname and validates only the final fanout node; it neither verifies nor descriptor-binds the objects ancestor before mkdir/link. Fresh scripts/verify_wp03_evidence.py, its rebuild/replay, all 153 gate tests, and six focused r1 regression tests passed, so current evidence does not cover this reachable post-initialization path replacement.
findings.required_fix: Descriptor-bind the attested objects, staging, and lock roots and perform fanout creation, staging creation, publication/link, fsync, and cleanup relative to verified no-follow directory descriptors whose device/inode identities are rechecked for every operation. At minimum reject any replaced ancestor before the first filesystem mutation, but avoid a check/use pathname race. Add gate-bound post-initialization replacement tests for top-level objects, staging, locks, and resources paths, asserting zero nodes, bytes, modes, or links appear outside the repository even on injected failure/crash points.
